choices.why: Its pale whitewashed wood top and slim black metal base suit the Nordic light-wood brief and echo the black window frames, and its compact size fits neatly beside the window.
This light oak swivel chair with a padded linen seat is comfortable for working and matches the light-wood, natural-fabric look.
At 193 cm, this light natural-wood bookcase with cane doors gives plenty of room for books and sits warmly against the white right-hand wall.
This soft beige wingback is a cozy, enveloping reading chair whose pale fabric keeps the corner bright and Scandinavian.
This slim, adjustable black reading lamp directs light onto the book without crowding the corner, and its black finish ties in with the window frames and the desk base.

answer.why: Light woods, linen and beige fabrics, and thin black metal accents create a calm, coherent Nordic work-and-reading corner that matches the pale floor, white walls and black window frames.
